uncited: Unlike static NeRF variants, these methods explicitly model motion, distinguishing themselves from siblings like [Relighting and Shading](17925-relighting-and-shading.md) which handle lighting changes, or [View Synthesis and Morphing](17926-view-synthesis-and-morphing.md) which may focus on interpolation without explicit physical motion modeling.
